the event‐related delta oscillations (ERD/ERS) of Alzheimer patients are significantly altered in a way that the ERD is reduced and the ERS is enhanced in the parieto‐occipital cortex.
the EROs in AD are characterized by a reduced delta response amplitude and increased delta response latency.
